entities.name: Helga
entities.description: A frogfolk of Pondside who has true visions, who wakes in Goodhill and joins Mabel's party to Pondside.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: A mousefolk of Goodhill, a mother and rapier wielder who takes up her ancestor's fang-sword and leads a party to Pondside.

entities.name: Clem
entities.description: Mabel's husband, a baker who supports her decision.

entities.name: Rosalyn
entities.description: Mabel's eldest child, solemn and responsible.

entities.name: Foggy
entities.description: One of Mabel's children.

entities.name: Pip
entities.description: Mabel's youngest child.

entities.name: Oliver
entities.description: The cinnamon-brown rabbit mayor of Goodhill who dismisses Helga's story.

entities.name: Finneas
entities.description: A sable-furred rabbitfolk archer who volunteers to go to Pondside.

entities.name: Hugs
entities.description: A gruff old badger who volunteers.

entities.name: Gev
entities.description: A lizardfolk fire-mace performer who joins Hugs.

entities.name: Zoraline
entities.description: A batfolk cleric who feels drawn to Pondside by the stars.

entities.name: Porfirio
entities.description: A batfolk cleric at the party.

entities.name: Silver
entities.description: A bard who plays at the party.

entities.name: Vann
entities.description: A neighbor who made chamomile fizzy drink and blackberry punch.

entities.name: Reed
entities.description: A frogfolk who gave Helga clothes.

entities.name: Iris
entities.description: Mabel's mother, who passed on the fang-sword.

entities.name: King Glarb
entities.description: Helga's weaving teacher in Fountainport.

entities.name: Lily of the Valley
entities.description: A champion of holly said to have wielded the sword Cragflame against the Calamity Beasts, and Mabel's many-greats-grandmother.

entities.name: Maha, the Night Owl
entities.description: The Calamity Beast that attacked Pondside.

entities.name: Wildfire Wolf
entities.description: A Calamity Beast whose fang is said to have formed the sword.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Fearsome heralds of seasonal and chaotic change, kept away from Valley since the weavers' great weavings.

entities.name: The fang-sword
entities.description: A sword made from a massive tooth with a flame-shaped pommel, said to be Lily of the Valley's, which glows when Mabel wields it.

entities.name: Goodhill
entities.description: The town in Valley where Mabel's party takes place.

entities.name: Pondside
entities.description: The village attacked by the Night Owl.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: A haven within high hills that has lived in peace.

entities.name: Fountainport
entities.description: The city where Helga studied under King Glarb.

entities.name: Kell's Ridge
entities.description: A battle after which, Oliver says, Calamity Beasts stopped troubling Valley.

entities.name: Order of the Holly Leaf
entities.description: An order of heroes from the time of the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: The animalfolk plane that suffers the Calamity Beasts.

events.summary: Helga wakes in Goodhill in Mabel's home after dreaming of the Night Owl and of a weaselfolk in a red hood.
events.quote: She'd been dreaming of the Night Owl.

events.summary: Helga tells Mabel, Clem and Oliver about Maha's attack and the destruction of Pondside, but Oliver doubts her.
events.quote: Your imagination seems a touch overactive, which is to be expected of an artistic temperament.

events.summary: Oliver reassures the guests that Calamity Beasts do not trouble Valley, while Helga recalls the history of weavers and Lily of the Valley.
events.quote: The unpredictable ones, the Blight Snake and the Drought Cat and so on, don't intrude on the affairs of us little folk in Valley.

events.summary: Mabel tells Helga that she believes her visions, and decides someone must travel to Pondside.
events.quote: "Someone must travel to Pondside," Mabel said.

events.summary: Mabel retrieves her family's fang-sword from the attic and its sigils glow for the first time.
events.quote: The sigils on the blade briefly gave off a faint reddish light

events.summary: At the lively birthday party Helga appears in the doorway and Oliver gives his speech praising Mabel.
Mabel publicly defends Helga, announces she will go to Pondside, and reveals the fang-sword, which sheens with flame.
events.quote: a faint sheen of flame rippled along the carved tooth from hilt to tip.

events.summary: Finneas, Hugs, Gev, Zoraline and Helga volunteer to accompany Mabel to Pondside.
Mabel says goodbye to her children and Clem before leaving at first light.
events.quote: "You are my sweet and brave little mouselings, and I will love you from spring to winter and back again."

relations.quote: I'm Mabel, and this is my husband, Clem.
The child had her father's coloring and her mother's nose

relations.note: Iris is Mabel's mother who passed on the sword.
relations.quote: Mabel's mother Iris had said when she passed it on to her daughter.

relations.note: Oliver is the mayor of Goodhill.
relations.quote: as mayor of this fine town

relations.note: Mabel believes Helga's visions and takes her to Pondside.
relations.quote: That she has visions, true visions, and isn't exaggerating or inventing a single thing.

relations.note: Lily is believed to be Mabel's many-greats-grandmother.
relations.quote: whether Lily really was your many-greats-grandmother

relations.note: Helga was King Glarb's apprentice in weaving.
relations.quote: I studied weaving with King Glarb in Fountainport, as his apprentice.
